hero.introduction: We connect businesses, investors, institutions and governments to advance market access, collaboration and sustainable growth across the USA, Africa and the Middle East.

categories.title: Chambers & Business Associations
categories.description: Bilateral chamber representation, business council management, and official delegation hosting.
categories.deliverables: Representation scope, stakeholder mapping, and bilateral policy advocacy.

categories.title: Investment & Financial Institutions
categories.description: Connecting institutional capital, sovereign funds, and accredited allocators with verified regional investment projects.
categories.deliverables: Investor mapping, deal readiness advisory, and private salon facilitation.

categories.title: Technology & Innovation
categories.description: Accelerating cross-border tech deployment, digital transformation partnerships, and climate innovation transfer.
categories.deliverables: Ecosystem matching, pilot facilitation, and corporate partnership structuring.

categories.title: Trade, Exhibitions & Market Promotion
categories.description: Curating high-level trade platforms, country pavilions, and targeted B2B matchmaking programs.
categories.deliverables: Delegation curation, pavilion management, and executive event operations.

categories.title: Development & Institutional Partnerships
categories.description: Joint bilateral initiatives driving inclusive economic growth, female founder linkages, and youth workforce integration.
categories.deliverables: Program design, export readiness execution, and measurable impact tracking.

governance.title: Partnership Integrity & Verification
governance.description: Teba Connects distinguishes signed partners, prior institutional engagements, and prospective collaborations. All institutional partner marks and relationship descriptions reflect authorized engagements.

cta.title: Explore Partnership Opportunities
cta.subtitle: We welcome collaborations with chambers, financial allocators, and industry leaders that create meaningful commercial impact.
